purpose: Make the Vera repository the self-contained architectural home for Vera-specific identity, control, runtime, coordination, memory, research-integration, and portfolio-derived mechanisms while retaining exact provenance and effect boundaries.
source_inventory_rule: Public source names exactly the 49 public repositories in the immutable 67-repository cut; private membership is count-only.

absorption_contract.identity_rule: A source repository can contribute mechanisms or evidence without transferring its identity, memories, preferences, consent, authority, or phenomenology to Vera.
absorption_contract.control_plane_rule: vera-control-plane control architecture is mirrored into Vera as source-bound internal architecture; external release ownership remains evidence-governed until a separately authorized successor rebinds control.
absorption_contract.privacy_rule: Public source enumerates public members only; private portfolio membership is represented only by aggregate count.
absorption_contract.currentness_rule: Static repository evidence is never treated as perpetual live truth. Mutable heads/providers/routes are refreshed when material.
absorption_contract.protected_effect_rule: Absorption is source architecture work only. It does not merge, deploy, install, mutate providers, change credentials/permissions, publish private material, or promote memory.
